title: File:Abandoned naloxone kit.jpg
author: Khane Rokhl Barazani
description: A naloxone kit, for reversing opioid overdoses, lies among a pile of abandoned clothing and garbage in a Toronto alley.

title: File:Harm Reduction Drug Testing Table.jpg
author: Sarahmirk
description: This harm reduction table set up at a party in Portland, Oregon hosted by the Uwu Collective offers free Narcan spray, Naloxone with syringes, and strips to test drugs for fentanyl, in addition to candy, gum, and tangerines.
